Requirements

Requirement: Report state of charge REQ_SOC
status: open
tags: soc, display
satisfied by: SPEC_SOC_LINEAR
verified by: TC_SOC_CLAMP, TC_SOC_RANGE

The system shall report the state of charge of the 12 V pack as a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
Requirement: Warn on low battery REQ_LOW_WARN
status: open
tags: warning, driver
satisfied by: SPEC_LOW_THRESHOLD
verified by: TC_LOW_BELOW, TC_LOW_EDGE

The system shall warn the driver when the pack voltage falls below the low threshold.
Requirement: Log voltage samples REQ_LOG
status: draft
tags: diagnostics
satisfied by: SPEC_LOG_FORMAT

The system shall store every voltage sample with a timestamp for workshop diagnostics.
